title: Preallocate foreign-key data prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when foreign-key table value scans build data:<table>: prefixes from known table-name length.
implementation: Added foreign_key_data_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Foreign-key data-prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving FK insert, update, parent-delete, COPY constraint, and composite FK behavior.
